paragraphs: Mentioned in Nedarim, chapter 8, halakhah 1, reporting in the name of Rabbi Zeira. The statement is repeated in Midrash Shmuel, chapter 17, where Hyman calls “bar Zeira” erroneous: it should read “in the name of Rabbi Zeira.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The proposed correction replaces a patronymic, “son of Zeira,” with a report formula, “in the name of Rabbi Zeira.”

The Guggenheimer Nedarim 8:1 paragraph has Rabbi Ba Chasida in the name of Rabbi Zeira; the Krakow 1893 digital Midrash Shmuel 17:3 has R’ Ba Chasida bar R’ Zeira. These support the reported contrast; changing the patronymic to a transmission formula remains Hyman’s proposed correction.
